summary: SettingsParameters is a frozen dataclass capturing all inputs needed to create a settings instance: config files, settings class, env prefix, secrets dir, secrets provider, and runtime kwargs. Its custom __hash__/__eq__ exclude kwargs, enabling LRU-cache reuse when only runtime overrides differ. merge() combines two instances with configurable precedence.
lifecycle_notes: frozen=True — SettingsParameters instances are immutable after creation
Structural parameters (config_files, settings_class, env_prefix, secrets_dir, secrets_provider) determine hash identity; kwargs are excluded
merge() combines config_files by union+dedup; scalars by last-wins (or first if prioritise_base=True); kwargs by dict merge
documentation_hooks: Caching split: structural params → LRU cache key; runtime kwargs → applied post-cache via apply_runtime_overrides()
merge() raises ValueError if both SettingsParameters specify different settings_class values
risks: merge() with config_files from both sides deduplicates by string representation — UPath vs str of the same file may not deduplicate correctly
